question: The Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS) 2023, aimed at replacing the Criminal Procedure Code was introduced by _________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Home Minister Amit Shah**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Home Minister Amit Shah** introduced the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS) 2023.
 
• The BNSS 2023 aims at replacing the existing Criminal Procedure Code in India.
 
• This legislative move is part of broader reforms intended to update and streamline the criminal justice system in India.
 
• The introduction of BNSS 2023 reflects the government's commitment to enhancing public safety and ensuring a more efficient legal process.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Criminal Procedure Code** (CrPC) is a comprehensive statute that outlines the procedural aspects of criminal law in India.
 
• Reforms such as the BNSS 2023 are essential for addressing contemporary challenges in law enforcement and judicial processes.
 
• The introduction of new legislative frameworks often involves extensive consultation and review to ensure they meet the current needs of the society while upholding justice and fairness.
 
• The Home Ministry plays a crucial role in the formulation and implementation of policies related to internal security and law enforcement in India.
